source_description: Bureau of Indian Standards (Conformity Assessment) Regulations and Official Fee Schedules

schemes.title: Product Certification Scheme (Scheme-I / ISI Mark)
schemes.full_name: Scheme-I: Standard Mark (ISI) Conformity Assessment Scheme for Domestic Manufacturers
schemes.target_audience: Domestic Manufacturers in India producing goods covered under Indian Standards
schemes.applicable_scope: Industrial, engineering, consumer, electrical, chemical, and building materials requiring ISI mark certification.

fee_schedule.inspection_charge: ₹7,000 per man-day + actual travel and lodging expenses
fee_schedule.minimum_marking_fee: Varies by product category (Typically ₹25,000 to ₹1,00,000 per annum)
fee_schedule.concessions: 80% concession on application and minimum marking fees for Micro Enterprises (valid for 3 years); 50% concession for Startups and Women Entrepreneurs.

steps: 1. **Online Application**: Register on the `manakonline.in` portal and submit Form-V along with manufacturing process details.
2. **Document Upload**: Upload Factory Registration Certificate, Machinery List, Testing Equipment calibration records, and Quality Manual.
3. **Application Fee Payment**: Pay the non-refundable application fee of **₹1,000** online.
4. **Factory Inspection**: BIS Inspecting Officer conducts on-site factory verification (Fee: **₹7,000/man-day**), inspects testing facilities, and draws sealed samples.
5. **Sample Testing**: Factory samples are tested at a BIS Recognized Laboratory for full standard compliance.
6. **Grant of Licence**: Upon successful verification, BIS issues the Performance Licence granting permission to apply the ISI Mark.
required_documents: Factory Registration Certificate / MSME Udyam Registration
Manufacturing Machinery list with capacity and power details
In-house testing equipment list with valid calibration certificates
Plant layout and manufacturing process flow chart
Quality Control Manual and appointment of qualified QC personnel
Consent letter from BIS recognized lab if external testing is required

timelines.normal_procedure: 45 to 60 days from complete application submission
timelines.simplified_procedure: 30 days for products eligible under simplified scheme
timelines.licence_validity: 2 Years initially, renewable for 1 to 5 years

schemes.title: Compulsory Registration Scheme (Scheme-II / CRS)
schemes.full_name: Scheme-II: Self-Declaration of Conformity (CRS) for Electronic & IT Goods
schemes.governing_regulation: BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018 - Scheme II & MeitY/MHI Orders
schemes.applicable_scope: Consumer electronics, IT equipment, solar inverters, batteries, LED lighting, and smart devices notified under CRS.

fee_schedule.test_report_validity: 90 Days from BIS Recognized LIMS Lab
fee_schedule.processing_fee: ₹50,000 per application (including model family additions as per schedule)
fee_schedule.concessions: Standard processing timeline and rates applicable across all eligible IT manufacturers.

steps: 1. **Sample Testing**: Send product samples to a BIS Recognized Laboratory in India to test compliance against applicable IS standard.
2. **Online Registration**: Register on the `crsbis.in` portal after obtaining the valid 90-day lab test report.
3. **Application Submission**: Submit Self-Declaration of Conformity along with technical test reports and manufacturer declarations.
4. **Registration Grant**: BIS verifies documents online and issues the Registration Number (R-Number) without physical factory inspection.
required_documents: Test Report from BIS Recognized Lab (issued within 90 days)
Self-Declaration of Conformity (SDoC) in prescribed format
Manufacturing unit business license / incorporation certificate
Brand/Trademark authorization letter if brand owner differs from manufacturer
Authorized Indian Representative (AIR) documents for foreign manufacturers
Critical Component List (CCL) and PCB layout schematics

timelines.registration_timeline: 15 to 20 working days post test report submission
timelines.licence_validity: 2 Years initially, renewable for 2 to 5 years

schemes.title: Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme (FMCS)
schemes.full_name: Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme (FMCS) for Overseas Facilities
schemes.governing_regulation: BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018 - Foreign Manufacturers Scheme
schemes.target_audience: Manufacturers located outside India exporting goods to India
schemes.applicable_scope: Any product covered under mandatory or voluntary Indian Standards manufactured outside India.

fee_schedule.inspection_charge: Actual international travel, lodging, and per-diem costs for BIS Inspecting Officers
fee_schedule.marking_fee: Calculated as per product marking rate in USD equivalent

steps: 1. **AIR Appointment**: Appoint an Authorized Indian Representative (AIR) legally resident in India.
2. **Application Submission**: Submit physical and online application with factory layout and quality manuals.
3. **Overseas Factory Inspection**: BIS officers travel to the overseas facility to inspect manufacturing and draw samples.
4. **Sample Testing & Grant**: Samples are tested in India. Upon passing and submitting the $10,000 PBG, the ISI mark licence is granted.
required_documents: Form-V application along with detailed factory layout and machinery list
Authorized Indian Representative (AIR) agreement and proof of residency in India
Proof of factory registration issued by foreign national authorities
In-house laboratory test equipment list and calibration reports
Manufacturing process flow chart and raw material test certificates
Irrevocable Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) of USD $10,000 from an RBI-approved bank

timelines.processing_time: 90 to 180 days (depending on visa, travel logistics, and lab testing)

schemes.title: Conformity Assessment for Capital Goods & Machinery (Scheme-X)
schemes.full_name: Scheme-X: Conformity Assessment for Capital Goods, Machinery, and Customized Equipment
schemes.target_audience: Manufacturers of Custom-Built Machinery, Heavy Industrial Equipment & Sub-Assemblies
schemes.applicable_scope: Pumps, compressors, customized gearboxes, pressure vessels, and heavy manufacturing machinery.

fee_schedule.inspection_charge: ₹7,000 per man-day for design & audit verification
fee_schedule.testing_basis: Design calculation appraisal & in-situ prototype testing
fee_schedule.surveillance_charge: ₹7,000 per man-day for periodic technical audits

steps: 1. **Design Documentation**: Submit detailed engineering drawings, stress calculations, and component bill of materials.
2. **Technical Audit**: BIS technical experts audit the design methodology and manufacturing quality system.
3. **Factory & Field Testing**: On-site prototype testing and performance validation under operating conditions.
4. **Certificate of Conformity**: BIS issues Certificate of Conformity allowing equipment deployment.
required_documents: Detailed engineering design calculations, drawings, and component specifications
Quality management system documentation conforming to ISO 9001
Raw material traceability reports and mill test certificates
Factory manufacturing setup and inspection apparatus list
Type test reports of safety components and subsystems

timelines.audit_duration: 30 to 45 days post design document submission

schemes.title: Gold & Silver Jewellery Hallmarking Scheme
schemes.full_name: Hallmarking Scheme for Gold & Silver Jewellery and Artifacts under BIS Act 2016
schemes.governing_regulation: BIS (Hallmarking) Regulations, 2018 & Mandatory Hallmarking Orders (IS 1417 / IS 2112)
schemes.target_audience: Jewellers, Gold Refineries, and Assaying & Hallmarking Centres (AHC)
schemes.applicable_scope: Gold jewellery (14K, 18K, 20K, 22K, 23K, 24K) and Silver articles marketed in notified districts.

fee_schedule.jeweller_registration: Free for Micro Enterprises; Tiered for Small/Medium/Large Jewellers
fee_schedule.hallmarking_charge: ₹45 per gold article / ₹35 per silver article (+ GST)
fee_schedule.minimum_ahc_batch_charge: ₹200 minimum per consignment at Assaying & Hallmarking Centre
fee_schedule.consumer_compensation_rule: Two times (2x) the purity discrepancy value refunded to consumer on verified defects

steps: 1. **Jeweller Online Registration**: Jewellers register online on the `manakonline.in` portal under the BIS Hallmarking Scheme.
2. **Submit to AHC**: Jeweller submits gold jewellery lots to a BIS Recognized Assaying & Hallmarking Centre (AHC).
3. **Assaying & Laser Marking**: AHC performs fire assay testing for karat purity (e.g., 22K/916, 18K/750, 14K/585) and laser-marks the BIS logo, purity grade, and unique 6-digit HUID.
4. **Verification on BIS CARE**: Consumer can scan and verify jewellery authenticity and jeweller details instantly via the **BIS CARE App**.
required_documents: Proof of establishment / GST Registration Certificate of Jewellery Outlet
Aadhaar / PAN card of Proprietor / Partners / Directors
Turnover declaration for fee slab determination (Micro/Small/Medium/Large)
Location coordinates and premises ownership / lease deed

timelines.registration_issuance: Instant / Within 1 working day online without manual audit
timelines.hallmarking_turnover_at_ahc: Within 4 to 8 hours per batch at registered AHC

schemes.title: Certificate of Conformity (Scheme-III / CoC)
schemes.full_name: Scheme-III: Certificate of Conformity for Granular Batch & Lot Production
schemes.target_audience: Manufacturers needing one-time or batch-based conformity certification
schemes.applicable_scope: Industrial inputs, specific building components, and non-continuous production batches.

fee_schedule.testing_fee: Actual test charges at BIS Recognized Lab

steps: 1. **Application**: Apply on `manakonline.in` under Scheme-III with batch size and standard specification.
2. **Lot Inspection**: BIS officer inspects the manufactured lot and draws representative samples.
3. **Testing**: Samples tested in recognized laboratory against standard parameters.
4. **CoC Issuance**: Certificate of Conformity issued for the inspected batch upon compliance.
required_documents: Batch production records and consignment invoices
Internal test and inspection certificates for the specified lot
Factory manufacturing setup and testing facilities evidence

timelines.timeline: 20 to 30 days depending on sample testing duration

schemes.title: Simplified Licensing Procedure (Tatkal / Scheme-I Option)
schemes.full_name: Simplified Licensing Procedure for Grant of Licence (Scheme-I Fast-Track)
schemes.governing_regulation: BIS Grant of Licence Guidelines (Simplified Procedure)
schemes.target_audience: Domestic manufacturers with pre-tested independent lab reports for notified products
schemes.applicable_scope: Over 80% of product standards notified under BIS Simplified Procedure list.

fee_schedule.inspection_charge: ₹7,000 per man-day (conducted post-licence or within 30 days)
fee_schedule.processing_timeline: Target grant within 30 days from complete submission
fee_schedule.concessions: 80% fee concession for Micro units, 50% for Startups and Women-led units

steps: 1. **Pre-Testing**: Get factory samples tested at a BIS Recognized Lab beforehand (report validity 90 days).
2. **Online Submission**: Submit application on `manakonline.in` with passing test report and in-house testing proof.
3. **Document Verification**: BIS conducts online verification of application and test report within 15-20 days.
4. **Fast-Track Grant**: Licence is granted immediately, followed by post-grant surveillance factory inspection.
required_documents: Passing Test Report from BIS Recognized Lab (within 90 days)
Manufacturing and testing equipment lists with valid calibration
Consent letter for post-grant verification audit

schemes.title: ECO Mark Scheme (Environment-Friendly Products)
schemes.full_name: ECO Mark Scheme for Environment-Friendly Consumer & Industrial Goods
schemes.governing_regulation: Environment (Protection) Act & BIS ECO Mark Guidelines
schemes.target_audience: Manufacturers producing environment-friendly goods meeting dual BIS and MoEFCC standards
schemes.applicable_scope: Soaps, detergents, paints, paper, plastics, batteries, textiles, cosmetics, and architectural materials.

fee_schedule.testing_fee: Standard Indian Standard testing fee + environmental criteria testing charges

steps: 1. **Quality Compliance**: Ensure product complies with the base Indian Standard (e.g., IS specification).
2. **Environmental Criteria**: Meet MoEFCC environmental criteria (biodegradability, non-toxicity, recyclable packaging).
3. **Online Application**: Apply on `manakonline.in` with dual compliance documentation.
4. **Inspection & Grant**: Combined factory inspection and granting of ECO Logo along with ISI Mark.
required_documents: Pollution Control Board (SPCB) consent to operate (CTO) certificate
Raw material environmental safety data sheets (MSDS)
Recyclability and non-toxic packaging certifications

provenance.regulation: MoEFCC / BIS ECO Mark Scheme Guidelines
